sentences.en: We must get rid of this foul garbage right away.
sentences.zh: 我们必须立刻清除这股恶臭的垃圾。

sentences.en: In her home, kitchen garbage was fed to the pigs.
sentences.zh: 在家里，厨余垃圾被喂给了猪。

sentences.en: The older a town is, the more garbage it produces.
sentences.zh: 一个城镇越古老，产生的垃圾就越多。

senses.zh: 垃圾,脏东西,丢弃的食物,无用的数据
